name: OXB
recent: Oxford Innotech Berhad 近期公告主要涉及董事及主要股东的股权变动，包括独立非执行董事 Khoo Lay Tatt 在闭市期间减持，以及执行董事 Oh Yen San、董事经理 Ng Thean Gin 等人在 9 月于公开市场增持。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收与净利均录得同比增长。
notable: 独立非执行董事 Khoo Lay Tatt 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日在闭市期间以每股 RM0.610 减持 200,000 股。
执行董事 Oh Yen San 与董事经理 Ng Thean Gin 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日至 14 日期间在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
risks: 独立非执行董事 Khoo Lay Tatt 在闭市期间减持股份。
董事及主要股东在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间出现多项股权变动申报。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 24,547,000，环比增长 37.7%，同比增长 43.7%；净利为 MYR 4,155,000，环比增长 27.7%，同比增长 162.5%；净利率为 16.9%，低于上一季度的 18.2%。

recent_en: Oxford Innotech Berhad's recent announcements mainly involve changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including Independent Non-Executive Director Khoo Lay Tatt disposing shares during the closed period, and Executive Director Oh Yen San and Managing Director Ng Thean Gin acquiring shares in the open market in September. Revenue and net profit for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 both grew year-on-year.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Khoo Lay Tatt disposed 200,000 shares at RM0.610 per share on 27 October 2026 during the closed period.
Executive Director Oh Yen San and Managing Director Ng Thean Gin acquired shares in the open market multiple times between 10 and 14 September 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Khoo Lay Tatt disposed shares during the closed period.
Multiple shareholding change announcements by directors and substantial shareholders occurred between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 24,547,000, up 37.7% QoQ and 43.7% YoY; net profit was MYR 4,155,000, up 27.7% QoQ and 162.5% YoY; net margin was 16.9%, lower than 18.2% in the previous quarter.
